title: SpeedGuard Helmet
summary: AI-based smart helmet for two-wheeler riders. I built the deep learning part that detects unsafe situations. The bike starts only when the helmet is worn, and location and speed go to a mobile app over Bluetooth.

title: AcciPredict (RoadGuard AI)
summary: Predicts road accidents from weather, road type, traffic, speed limit, driver age, alcohol involvement and visibility to highlight risk factors.

title: World Cancer Prediction
summary: Classifies breast tumors as malignant or benign using cleaned clinical data, feature selection and model evaluation.

title: Romaxion (Heartalytix)
summary: Analyzes 30 days of relationship data, tracking trust, mood, affection and jealousy to find emotional patterns over time.

title: Cyber Attack Analysis
summary: Explores attack types, trends and geographic spread in a cyber attack dataset, turning raw logs into charts for security decisions.

title: Secure Vault
summary: Password manager that stores and organizes credentials in one place, with a password generator and secure storage.

title: Network Protocol Testing
summary: Menu-driven toolkit that tests network protocol behavior and performance, with captured results from each test.

title: FlowNetix
summary: Redundant three-floor network with dual ISPs. Each department has its own VLAN and subnet, with trunk and access ports, OSPF, DHCP, SSH, port security and PAT.

title: TrackMyClass
summary: Linux shell system for class records. Add, view, search, update and delete students, teachers, courses, parents and sports participants.

title: Luxury Corner
summary: Premium real-estate website with property galleries, smooth scrolling and a refined, image-led layout.
